title: Eyes of Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: Chen Ji, in a daze, sensed a strange presence. The black-clad figure slowly squatted down, his voice hoarse yet familiar: "You've finally reached this point, my brother..."

text.content: The Tianji Record raged within his Brow Center, golden patterns searing Chen Ji's Mental Sea like branding irons. That surge of bloodline connection was overwhelming, as if another "self" was gazing at him through some mystical bond. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "He's here... he's come. Chen Ji, are you prepared?" Chen Ji offered no reply, for a blade-sharp killing intent was already sweeping forth from the depths of the valley.

Han Lie's form plummeted like a meteorite, crashing down ten zhang away. The Xuanwu Sect's Black Iron Battle Armor gleamed with a cold, eerie luster under the moonlight. Behind him followed more than ten powerful cultivators, completely encircling the valley. "Wretch," Han Lie grinned, his smile brimming with long-suppressed hatred, "Today marks your death. The three great sects have reached consensus—no Tianqing Sect trash survives."

dialogue.content: Did you think hiding in this desolate wilderness would save you from my pursuit? Chen Ji, you're too naive. From the moment you humiliated me at the Sect Competition, I vowed—every bone in your body, I will shatter with my own hands!

text.content: Chen Ji rose slowly, a faint, composed smile curling his lips. Beneath that worthless shell, his cold heart raced at lightning speed. The Tianji Record's vibrations intensified, seemingly urging him to make a choice. The Eyes of Breaking the Game—that was a forbidden pupil technique he had never fully executed. Today, perhaps it was time to unleash it. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded once more: "The Eyes of Breaking the Game can penetrate all formations and weaknesses within three hours, but the price... are you certain you wish to employ it in this situation?"

choice.prompt: Faced with Han Lie's encirclement and assassination, Chen Ji needed to make a choice. The power of the Eyes of Breaking the Game was formidable, yet it carried an unknown price.

choices.text: Fully unleash the Eyes of Breaking the Game
choices.description: Bet everything, completely activate the Eyes of Breaking the Game, to pierce through all enemy formations and weaknesses, though this might drain a massive amount of Heavenly Fate and bring unknown side effects.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -15 points, possible unknown side effects
choices.visible_reward: Pierce through all formations and weaknesses within three hours
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Eyes of Breaking the Game has yet to be fully mastered; forcibly activating it may exact a heavy price

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, the golden patterns at his Brow Center suddenly blazing with light. Gritting his teeth, he poured his entire consciousness into the Tianji Record fragment. Eyes of Breaking the Game—OPEN! In an instant, the entire world turned transparent before his eyes. Han Lie's and others' formations revealed themselves like a three-dimensional chessboard. Every weak point in the formations, every starting motion of lethal techniques, every flaw in each person—all laid bare, nothing hidden.

choices.text: Conserve the Eyes of Breaking the Game
choices.description: Only activate a fraction of the Eyes of Breaking the Game's power, acquiring critical information without pursuing complete vision, thereby reducing risk but potentially missing important details.
choices.visible_reward: Acquire key weaknesses of the main threats
choices.risk_hint: Partial activation may fail to pierce through all traps

text.content: Chen Ji gathered his focus, merely projecting a wisp of his consciousness into the Tianji Record. The power of the Eyes of Breaking the Game surged into his Mental Sea like a tide, but he forcibly restrained it within a controllable range. In his hazy vision, he glimpsed a fissure in the formation behind Han Lie—the corner of the Xuanwu Sect's sect-protecting grand formation, the "Xuanwu Spirit-Locking Formation," and the sole breakthrough point.

choices.text: Abandon use, break the situation with wisdom
choices.description: Rely not on the Eyes of Breaking the Game's power, but on his years of accumulated strategy and understanding of human nature, seeking survival in this desperate situation.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve full strength, seek other weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Facing such a disparity in power, the risk is extremely high

text.content: Chen Ji did not invoke the Tianji Record's power. He knew only too well that in this world, there are no free lunches—every borrowed strength will someday become a noose around one's neck. He surveyed his surroundings, his gaze sweeping across each enemy's face, every possible escape route. Han Lie... your greatest weakness is placing too much faith in your own strength.

"The fully activated Chen Ji was now in the complete awakening state of the Eye of Breaking the Game. The golden vertical pupil at his brow center slowly opened—that was the most primitive power within the Tianji Record Fragment: the Eye of Breaking the Game, capable of perceiving all cause-and-effect threads within three hours. 'What is this?!' Han Lie's face changed drastically. He felt an overwhelming force beyond comprehension gazing at him, as if his entire being had been completely seen through."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji smiled, and that smile was more irritating to Han Lie than any mockery: 'Han Lie, three zhang behind you, the eye of the 'Xuanwu Soul-Locking Formation' is located three inches below your left shoulder blade. The person on your right has a flaw in his True Qi circulation—he will expose an opening on the seventh breath after attacking. As for you—' Chen Ji's voice turned cold, 'your killing move 'Xuanwu Soul-Suppressing Fist' is weakest at the moment of initiation when your right shoulder sinks slightly. I only need to sidestep half a step at the instant you throw the punch, and your full-force strike will land on empty air.'"

text.content: "Han Lie's face instantly turned ashen. His trump card that he was proud of, his meticulously arranged lethal trap—viewed by thistrash as mere child's play! 'Kill him!' Han Lie roared as he struck first, Xuanwu True Force pouring into both fists, carrying enough momentum to crush mountains as he crashed toward Chen Ji. Yet Chen Ji's figure ghostly sidestepped, precisely evading the fiercest edge of the fist."

"The battlefield fell into chaos in an instant. The assault by over a dozen Xuanwu Sect experts was dismantled by Chen Ji with incredible precision, each strike after another. The Eye of Breaking the Game had laid out all cause-and-effect threads within three hours before his eyes—every movement of these people, every trace of True Qi flow, appeared to him like slow-motion footage. 'No... impossible!' For the first time, genuine fear appeared in Han Lie's voice."

dialogue.content: "trash? Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears. I was merely waiting for an opportunity, waiting for you self-proclaimed geniuses to personally deliver yourselves to my door. Before his words finished, his palm blade had already severed Han Lie's right arm meridian. Remember today's lesson, Han Lie—never give atrash a second chance."

choice.prompt: "Han Lie lay severely wounded on the ground, but the power of the Eye of Breaking the Game still burned. Chen Ji sensed something awakening deep within the Tianji Record—the backlash from fate—he had to make a choice."

choices.text: "Immediately stop the Eye of Breaking the Game"
choices.description: "Quit while ahead, immediately retract the power of the Eye of Breaking the Game. Though some information might be missed, this minimizes the risk of backlash."
choices.risk_hint: "The power of the Eye of Breaking the Game has already begun its backlash, but forcibly interrupting may cause more severe consequences"

text.content: "Chen Ji did not hesitate to retract his divine consciousness, severing the connection to the Eye of Breaking the Game. The price was smaller than he anticipated—just another ten points of Heavenly Fate consumed, along with a bout of intense vertigo. Leaning against the rocky wall to catch his breath, he coldly swept his gaze across Han Lie on the ground, then vanished into the night. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: 'Well done, but the price has already begun accumulating...'"

choices.text: "Continue to peer, search for the twin brother"
choices.description: "While the Eye of Breaking the Game still burns, continue to peer into the existence bound by blood far away—the twin brother he has never met. This may exact a greater price, but might uncover the true reason for the Tianji Record's vibrations."
choices.visible_reward: "Peered into the fate's clue about the twin brother"
choices.risk_hint: "Forcefully peering into an existence beyond fate, the price may be catastrophic"

text.content: "Chen Ji clenched his teeth, pushing the Eye of Breaking the Game to its extreme. Within the golden vertical pupil reflected a blurry figure—a man with a face almost identical to his own, standing in some dark hall. 'Found it...' Chen Ji's voice trembled, yet in the next instant, a soul-tearing agony exploded from his brow center. The Tianji Record shook frantically, countless cause-and-effect threads wrapped around him like chains, as if something was dragging him into the abyss. 'No...!'"

"No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the backlash of the Eye of Breaking the Game had finally arrived. It was an indescribable agony, as if countless needles were simultaneously piercing his Mental Sea, as if something was being extracted from the depths of his soul. His consciousness began to blur, the world before his eyes twisted and distorted, and countless cacophonous whispers filled his ears. Mo Xiansheng's voice became distant and ethereal: 'Chen Ji... hold on... this is Heavenly Fate's backlash...'"

"When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he faced an unfamiliar night sky. He lay in a pool of blood, the pungent smell reminding him he had been unconscious for quite some time. Worse yet—he discovered he couldn't recall anything. Three days. Yes, three full days of memories had vanished without a trace. He only remembered he was going somewhere, and then... then nothing."

"Just as Chen Ji struggled to stand, a black figure slowly approached. The newcomer wore a black outfit, face hidden in the shadow of a hood, yet that familiar, heart-stopping aura caused Chen Ji's pupils to contract sharply—it was resonance from deep within the bloodline, the source of the Tianji Record's vibrations. 'You're finally awake,' the black-clad figure crouched down, voice hoarse and low, 'my brother.'"

dialogue.content: "The black-clad figure reached out, fingertips touching the golden mark on Chen Ji's brow center that had yet to fade, voice carrying complex emotions: 'Do you know? That glance you took peering into fate just now nearly dragged us both into an inescapable abyss of doom. The Heavenly Eyes have already detected your existence... from now on, there is no retreat for either of us.'"

text.content: "Chen Ji tried to speak, only to find his throat so parched he couldn't make a sound. Twin brother... Heavenly Fate Lock Key... Heavenly Eyes... these words churned in his mind, yet like through a veil of mist. The black-clad figure's lips curled into a cold smile identical to his own: 'Don't rush. We have plenty of time. After all—' He stood up, moonlight finally illuminating half his face—it was a visage almost identical to Chen Ji's, 'we have been separated for a full twenty years.'"

"In the distance came successive dull thuds, seemingly people from the Three Great Sects searching this area. The black-clad figure furrowed his brow, taking a pitch-black Jade Slip from his怀 and pressing it into Chen Ji's hand: 'Everything that happened during these three days is recorded here. Once you recover your memories, you will naturally understand what to do.' He paused, his voice softening slightly, 'And... please give my regards to Xiao Nian. Tell her that her brother is still alive.'"

"Before the words finished, the black-clad figure's form had already dissipated into the night like blue smoke. Chen Ji clutched the cold Jade Slip in his hand, his heart churning with indescribable emotions. The Eye of Breaking the Game...，果然 required a price. But what concerned him more now—was the person claiming to be his twin brother friend or foe? Why did the Tianji Record choose him over his own blood relative? And what secrets lay hidden within that Jade Slip?"

Chen Ji forced himself to stand, wounds burning with sharp pain. He gazed at his blood-soaked robes, trying to recall what had happened three days prior—yet could only capture fragmented images: Han Lie's furious roar, the searing agony when the Breaking Eye blazed to life, and those identical eyes staring back at him. Mo Xiansheng's voice finally rang out again, carrying unprecedented weariness: "Chen Ji... the price has been paid. You must quickly remember what happened during these three days."

Just then, a familiar voice echoed from the distance—it was Su Qingyao. "Chen Ji! Where are you!" Chen Ji managed a bitter smile. How did this woman appear at such a time? He swiftly tucked the Jade Slip into his chest, straightened his disheveled appearance, and donned his usual timorous expression. After all... in the world three days from now, he had plenty of time to lay his plans. The price of the Breaking Eye was etched in his memory, and as for that twin brother—he would one day personally uncover every truth.

Footsteps drew nearer. Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly walked toward the source of the sound. His eyes gleamed with cold sharpness in the darkness, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. This chess game... had only just begun. Mo Xiansheng was right—the price was already accumulating, but true victory had never been about gains or losses in a single move. The complete form of the Tianji Record, the truth of the twin brother, the layout of the Heavenly Eye—all the riddles awaited him to solve.
In a daze, Chen Ji sensed a strange presence. The black-clad figure slowly crouched down, his voice hoarse yet achingly familiar: "You've finally reached this point, my brother..."
